question.text: Records of a Cat III AIF (AUM, valuation, strategies, investor details) must be maintained for at least:

answer.text: 5 years after winding up of the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.49, the Sponsor/Manager must maintain records for 5 years after winding up of the fund, including assets under the fund, valuation policies and practices, investment strategies, investor details and capital contribution, and the investment decision-making process. The Trap: The 1-year, 3-year, and 10-year periods do not match the 5-year post-winding-up retention rule stated in the workbook. Note: The 5-year post-winding-up retention and the listed record categories are taken directly from workbook p.49.
